messages:
alex_marketing: Quick sync — we need a small copy pass for the landing pages (hosted / dedicated / private). Goal: make pathing explicit so buyers land on the right flow.
emily_product: TL;DR — highlight 3 customer intents up front: fast integration, predictable capacity, and private control. one-liners for hero + supporting bullet.
sam_design: I can do layout options. thinking a 3-column hero vs single hero with toggle. mobile-first is key.
noah_growth: For experiments: create 2 variants. Variant A: single hero with micro-CTA buttons for each mode. Variant B: 3 distinct CTAs in columns. Track clicks -> funnel event `landing_mode_click` with prop `mode`.
rachel_sales: Make sure the form captures "org_size" and "use_case" and a hidden field for "expected_acv" so we can route enterprise leads to AE queue. example hidden fields:

```
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_segment\" value=\"enterprise\"> 
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"origin\" value=\"landing_hosted_dedicated_private\"> 
```

mia_copy: Draft copy for hero options — short, distinct, and testable.

Option 1 (hosted-focus primary):
- Hero headline: "Instant LLM inference — no ops required"
- Subhead: "Hosted API for fast time-to-value, predictable pricing, and streaming responses."
- CTA: "Get started — hosted"

Option 2 (dedicated-focus primary):
- Hero headline: "Dedicated GPU pools for production scale"
- Subhead: "Reserved capacity and SLAs for predictable throughput and isolation."
- CTA: "Talk to sales — dedicated"

Option 3 (private-focus primary):
- Hero headline: "Run inference in your network"
- Subhead: "VPC and on‑prem deployments with customer-managed keys and audit logs."
- CTA: "Request private demo"

alex_marketing: Love these. For the main landing (top nav) we should lead with a neutral gist then surface the three modes as quick action cards. Want copy that's convert-first for self-serve and also signals enterprise.
emily_product: Add a short 1-line differentiator under each card (latency / cost / compliance). Also include a small performance stat if we have one (e.g., "<50ms p50 on standard prompts") — only if validated.
noah_growth: We'll run a 2-week experiment. Setup:
- Traffic split 50/50
- UTM params: `?utm_experiment=threepath_v1`
- Events: landing_mode_click, signup_start, demo_request
- KPI: signup_start rate and demo_request rate

sam_design: I’ll mock the 3-card layout and the single-hero-with-mini-CTAs. Pushing frames by EOD.

rachel_sales: Routing rules — if expected_acv >= 50k or lead_segment==enterprise -> assign to AE Salesforce queue. Otherwise to SDR nurture. Also add checkbox for "Privacy-sensitive data" to flag for legal follow-up.
mia_copy: Quick iteration on microcopy for CTAs:
- Self-serve -> "Start free" / "Quickstart" / "Try hosted"
- Dedicated -> "Request capacity" / "Get a quote"
- Private -> "Schedule demo" / "Talk to our team"

alex_marketing: One more ask — weave in webinar CTA in footer for this month: "Webinar: How we measure production LLM costs". Use UTM `utm_campaign=webinar_march` and prefill form topic=webinar.

emily_product: Can someone draft the short paragraph about "what counts as private" — legal-friendly: mention VPC, on-prem, KMS, audit logs.
mia_copy: Drafting that now, will post here in 30m.

noah_growth: Tagging analytics: please standardize event names and text variants in a spreadsheet so we can map conversions to copy variations.

alex_marketing: Great. Action items:
- mia_copy: full copy variants for hero + cards (due tomorrow noon)
- sam_design: mocks (due today EOD)
- noah_growth: analytics plan + event names (due tomorrow morning)
- rachel_sales: routing rules + required form fields (confirm by EOD)
- emily_product: wording for "private" paragraph and stat check (ASAP)

alex_marketing: Ping me when mocks are in and I’ll schedule a short review. :thumbsup:
